status: OPEN NON-CONSENSUS RESEARCH CHALLENGE; NO GATE ASSESSED

candidate.header_utf8: Soveroot reproducible C++ benchmark matrix v1

qualification.purpose: small exact-output runner preflight; no reduced-memory eligibility claim

screening.purpose: compare deterministic exact prefixes under the existing bounded-work accounting

completion.purpose: find any exact half-memory attack before controlled physical-host measurement

included: memo, index, tag, bitmap, queue, and schedule metadata
native and explicit work stacks for every worker thread
transcripts, counters, buffers, and inter-thread communication
excluded: the read-only epoch dataset and 64-entry schedule available to every ordinary miner
fixed input seed, header, nonce, and parameter bytes
operating-system and runtime baseline measured before epoch preparation
forbidden: memory-mapped or compressed external backing stores
network helpers or hidden worker processes
future-aware traces, graphs, or schedules retained during an eligible run

operation_policy.total_rule: total_operations is the exact sum of every screening counter field
operation_policy.mapping_rule: Every attack-specific action must map to a declared counter; work that does not fit the first four fields is charged as other_charged_operations and explained.
operation_policy.completion_track: All counters remain mandatory and auditable, but there is no artificial operation ceiling; measured accepted-work throughput is considered only after an exact proof.

case_policy.evaluator_commitment: Before the submission freeze, the evaluator publishes SHA3-384(Soveroot/PowResearch/ExternalAttackEvaluatorSalt/v0\0 || 32-byte evaluator_salt).
case_policy.submission_freeze: After the evaluator commitment, the source revision, manifest, build instructions, and 32-byte submitter salt become immutable.
case_policy.fresh_selection: After the freeze, the evaluator reveals its salt. Eight unique uint32 indices are drawn from SHAKE-256(Soveroot/PowResearch/ExternalAttackFreshSeeds/v0\0 || evaluator_salt || submitter_salt || source_revision_bytes), skipping every previously used index. The salts, revision, exclusions, and complete case set are published.
case_policy.anti_overfitting_limit: Fresh cases are hidden only until the source revision is frozen; secrecy never substitutes for reproducibility or independent review.
case_policy.retention: All complete, exhausted, refused, invalid, and unfavorable rows are preserved.

submission_policy.license: source-available terms sufficient for reproduction and review
submission_policy.required_independence: Disclose copied code and prior collaboration; a second model requires independently developed attack logic, not only a language port.
submission_policy.untrusted_code: Submissions are never executed in project CI and must be built and run in a disposable, network-disabled evaluator environment.
required_artifacts: limitations and relationships to earlier attacks

decision_policy.exact_eligible_proof: Advance immediately to independent code review and controlled physical-memory and throughput measurements; redesign or reject according to the frozen gate thresholds.
decision_policy.partial_improvement: Preserve the result and review the new strategy, but do not assess or pass the time-memory gate.
decision_policy.no_successful_submission: Keep the gate OPEN and NOT ASSESSED; absence of a published attack is not proof of security.
decision_policy.invalid_accounting: Preserve the submission as ineligible evidence with the exact reason; do not silently repair or discard it.
